hints.title: Parent-to-Children Tree Building
hints.text: Model the parent-child relationships as a directed tree where edges point from parent process to child processes.

hints.title: Subtree Traversal from Target Process
hints.text: Starting from the kill target process, traverse all descendant nodes in the tree.

hints.title: Adjacency Map Breadth-First Expansion
hints.text: Build an adjacency list mapping each parent process identifier to its list of child process identifiers. Initialize a queue with the target process id, pop nodes, append them to the result list, and enqueue their children.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the entire ppid array recursively for every killed node takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Building a child adjacency list takes O(N) memory and allows subtree traversal in linear O(N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should represent the hierarchy as an adjacency map and use standard tree traversal (BFS or DFS).
